items.prompt: Black to move. If Black did nothing useful and White moved next, what would White play to win material or checkmate? Name that move, or choose 'No threat'.

claims.statement: Black has no piece that is attacked and undefended.
White has no piece that is attacked and undefended.
The engine's evaluation is within 1.5 pawns of equal (depth 16).

hints: Imagine it is the opponent's turn again. Which of their pieces could give check or capture something?
For each of their checks and captures, ask whether something of yours is left without a defender or without a flight square.
Check every piece of yours: is any of them attacked and undefended?
items.explain: Neither side has a piece that is attacked and undefended, and the engine rates the position within 1.5 pawns of equal (depth 16). A null-move engine search run when the item was built found no mating or material-winning move for White; the validator does not re-run that part.
